name: sts
description: Security Token Service Security Token Service (STS) enables you to request temporary, limited-privilege credentials for users.

subcommands.name: assume-role
subcommands.description: Returns a set of temporary security credentials that you can use to access Amazon Web Services resources.

subcommands.name: assume-role-with-saml
subcommands.description: Returns a set of temporary security credentials for users who have been authenticated via a SAML authentication response.

subcommands.name: assume-role-with-web-identity
subcommands.description: Returns a set of temporary security credentials for users who have been authenticated in a mobile or web application with a web identity provider.

subcommands.name: assume-root
subcommands.description: Returns a set of short term credentials you can use to perform privileged tasks on a member account in your organization.

subcommands.name: decode-authorization-message
subcommands.description: Decodes additional information about the authorization status of a request from an encoded message returned in response to an Amazon Web Services request.

subcommands.name: get-access-key-info
subcommands.description: Returns the account identifier for the specified access key ID.

subcommands.name: get-caller-identity
subcommands.description: Returns details about the IAM user or role whose credentials are used to call the operation.

subcommands.name: get-delegated-access-token
subcommands.description: Exchanges a trade-in token for temporary Amazon Web Services credentials with the permissions associated with the assumed principal.

subcommands.name: get-federation-token
subcommands.description: Returns a set of temporary security credentials (consisting of an access key ID, a secret access key, and a security token) for a user.

subcommands.name: get-session-token
subcommands.description: Returns a set of temporary credentials for an Amazon Web Services account or IAM user.

subcommands.name: get-web-identity-token
subcommands.description: Returns a signed JSON Web Token (JWT) that represents the calling Amazon Web Services identity.
